home.lede: Plan a new trip with AI or revisit your saved itineraries. Each plan includes hour-by-hour schedules, hotel options in all budget tiers, and web-searched prices.
home.feature1Body: Describe your trip once. Get a full day-by-day plan with real hotels, transport options, and activities.
home.feature2Body: Drag blocks between days, swap hotels, and trigger live web searches for flights, stays, and places.

wizard.title: Plan your trip
wizard.originDescription: We use this to estimate the inbound / outbound transport cost and suggest flight options.
wizard.destinationsDescription: Add one or more destinations, in the order you'll travel.
wizard.datesHeading: When are you in each city?
wizard.datesDescription: Set the arrive and leave date for every stop. Nights are auto-calculated. The trip's overall range is derived from these.
wizard.modeSelected: {{mode}} selected — the itinerary will use this to get you there.
wizard.travelersDescription: We use this to multiply meals, activity admissions, and hotel beds correctly.
wizard.advancedDescription: Pick a budget tier and what you care about. Everything else is optional.

generation.hint: Takes about 30–60 seconds. You can keep this tab open or leave — the plan saves automatically.
generation.overtime: Still working — heavy requests can take a few minutes
generation.skipAi: Too slow? Build without AI (Google search)

trip.claudeIsWorking: Claude is putting together your itinerary. This usually takes 20–60 seconds.
trip.stuckBody: The request may have failed silently. You can mark this as errored and start over, or delete it entirely.
trip.generationFailedBody: Something went wrong while creating this plan. Try generating a new trip.
trip.deleteConfirm: Delete Day {{n}}? This removes all its blocks, costs and hotels.
trip.regeneratePromptPlaceholder: e.g. make it more relaxed, less museums, include more local food

explore.heading: Discover a country or city
explore.subheading: Type a place to get a scannable overview: history, neighborhoods, food, where to stay and what to do. Perfect for research before you plan a trip.
explore.mapUnavailable: Map preview unavailable — click a place to open it in Google Maps.
explore.hint: Pulling together a rich overview — keeps running if you switch tabs.

map.fallbackHint: Using OpenStreetMap fallback tiles because VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN is not set.
map.couldNotResolve: Could not resolve any locations on the map.
map.cantPlace: Couldn't place {{count}} day{{plural}} on the map:

auth.signInDescription: Sign in with Google to save and share your trips.

notifications.enabled: Reminders enabled — you'll get a morning briefing on each trip day
notifications.denied: Notifications blocked — enable them in your browser settings to get trip reminders
